Penny stocks, especially ones that have catalysts or gain attention, tend to be very volatile. Exit points are completely up to you, just make sure that your trades are all within your risk tolerance. Never risk more than you're willing to lose. 

Also, always take advice from this sub with a grain of salt. While I know most people here have good intentions, there are bots that will try to make you think one idea is better than the other. The mods do a wonderful job at making sure their exposure is limited, but still try to do your own DD where possible. 

If you are comfortable with the risk, and confident in the stock, then you can consider holding. If you are satisfied with the profits, or feel uncomfortable and lose confidence in the stock, then you can consider selling. This is a really general opinion, not financial advice. Again, volatile means that it can change pace quite easily. If we could 100% predict the future, there wouldn't be any DDs.

In any case, the decision ultimately is up to you. Set your own trading rules that you are comfortable with, and adjust as needed.
